svg.title: linear-fixed-decay
svg.desc: Fixed per-head decay. Left: toy decay masks D_tj = γ^(t−j) for γ = 0.7 and γ = 0.95. RetNet experiments space 1−γ from 1/32 to 1/512, horizons of about 32 to 512 tokens. Right: MiniMax-01 lightning decay λ = exp(−s_h(1−ℓ/79)) with ALiBi slopes s_h = 2^(−h/8); the grid gives the horizon 1/(1−λ) in tokens per head and layer, from about 1.7 tokens (head 1, layer 0) to tens of thousands of tokens in the last lightning layer. Bottom: the 80-layer MiniMax-01 stack with one softmax layer after every seven lightning layers.

text.font-family: STIX Two Math,Cambria Math,Times New Roman,serif
